test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Megha said that she had taken the shortcut to her college.

options.text: Megha says, "She takes the shortcut to my college."
Megha said, "She takes the shortcut to her college."
Megha said, "I take the shortcut to my college."
Megha said," I took the shortcut to my college."

solution:
The correct answer is: **Megha said," I took the shortcut to my college."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reported verb 'said' remains the same in the reporting speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• If the indirect speech is written in the **past perfect tense**, then we have to change it in the **simple past tense** in direct speech. therefore **"had taken"** changes to "**took**" in the direct speech.
 
• The pronoun "**she**" changes to '**I**" in the direct speech.
 
• "**Her**" changes to "**my**" to show the direct speech part.
 
 

Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

Hence, the correct direct speech is - *Megha said," I took the shortcut to my college."*
